title: Planning rejects an obsolete observed reply
description: On an isolated gateway and loopback proxy, hold actual read A while owning writes B and C publish newer revisions. Duplicate an unchanged real notification, release the unchanged old reply and inspect every canonical cache transition plus the mounted panel. No UI or cache value injection.

proofTargets.claim: The actual obsolete planning reply reaches the production cache as stale and never becomes ready.
Two newer writes and a byte-identical duplicate notification share one pending read and exactly one follow-up read on the same connection.
Normal sign-out closes the owned browser session, the temporary backlog item is removed and original planning facts remain unchanged.

prove.intent: Race a held planning reply with two owning writes and duplicate notices.

old-reply.intent: The unchanged old reply must remain stale in every actual cache transition.

coalesce.intent: Share one pending read and one follow-up across actual duplicate notices.

cleanup.intent: Remove the owned row and browser session; preserve original planning facts.
